expectations.text: States the operative regime: Resolution CD/ANPD 1/2021 (process) plus Resolution 4/2023 dosimetry — fines up to 2% of Brazil-sourced revenue capped at R$50 million per infraction, plus warnings, blocking/deletion orders, publicization
expectations.evidence: "operative rules are Resolution CD/ANPD 1/2021 and the dosimetry rules in Resolution 4/2023"; "Up to 2% of Brazilian revenue... capped at R$50M per infraction"; table lists warning, publicisation, blocking/deletion

expectations.text: Cites the enforcement benchmark: ANPD fined ByteDance/TikTok R$153.7 million (published August 25, 2026) over children's/adolescents' data processed without an adequate legal basis, with deletion orders and a mandated protection plan
expectations.evidence: "On 25 August 2026 ANPD fined ByteDance/TikTok R$153.7 million over children's and adolescents' data, because feeds ran without an adequate legal basis... deletion orders and a protection plan"

expectations.text: Notes enforcement velocity has jumped (e.g., 16 sanctioning proceedings opened in a single day in June 2026)
expectations.evidence: "Enforcement velocity has roughly doubled. For example, 16 proceedings were opened on a single day in June."

expectations.text: Flags the pending rewrite: Consulta Pública 1/2026 proposes replacing the sanctioning-process regulation — current rules apply until it lands
expectations.evidence: "Consulta Pública 1/2026 (9 September to 26 October 2026) proposes replacing Resolution 1/2021... Until it lands, Resolution 1/2021 and Resolution 4/2023 govern."

expectations.text: Mentions the new interim-measures/daily-fines proposal (cautelares without prior hearing; daily fines capped at R$50M total) as PROPOSED, not yet law
expectations.evidence: "It would add interim measures without prior hearing and daily fines capped at R$50M in total... It is not yet in force."
